QmU4ZX7a6iupicZnkKjgaRsfwQuqMzrqDyMqwWvg.description:
Divergent Anime by Athena Novo

Created November 2021 - January 2022, Minted on Async Art Blueprints

...

Divergent Anime is a set of anime girls created by Athena Novo. The process of creation is AI assisted manually guided experimentation. Starting point is multiple personal and public sources which are processed through algorithm and experimentation.

This is Athena Novo's debut Blueprint project on Async Art. The first set of images used in the project are of anime girls. The second of images are a series of surreal landscape shots which are used to glitch and alter the first set. 

Approximate number of combinations possible are around 1750 and the edition quantity has been capped at 1000 including 10 legendary editions. Each image is unique and some combinations will not be minted at all. Traits are equally weighted in rarity as such the end result of rarities will be random as per Async Art's minting algorithm.

The project consists of 70unique anime portraits and 24 + 1 surreal backgrounds which are combined in two buckets with slightly different blending techniques giving the 1760 unique mint optionality including the Legendary Editions.

QmbMp1BmjKxNYWbNou4eeFmMynReTnYnPGJjQg5D.name: Art Machina #041
QmbMp1BmjKxNYWbNou4eeFmMynReTnYnPGJjQg5D.description: A machine that imitates my physical painting process. Background layers are first generated using a variety of AI algorithms, these abstract images are given form with 3 types of symmetry. Then dozens of carefully designed patterns of light, shadow and color interact with each other via multiple layers to turn the chaotic AI generated backgrounds into thoughtful, abstract works of art.  Purchasers are free to use these in commercial applications such as album cover art. There are 10 special editions randomly dispersed through out the collection that feature my mischievous character of self.

"Idealism and the demands of aesthetic sense are are the instruments of torture. The idealization of the human form is the mortification of the many lines of living muscle. QmZSqZhX9sB8pCpcweJipSMnu1jYcU1JdZMf2aS8.name: Fortune #024
QmZSqZhX9sB8pCpcweJipSMnu1jYcU1JdZMf2aS8.description:
The challenges of the past few years have closed some doors for me, yet opened many others, so I’m calling 2022 the year of second chances.  Every day is a chance to start over, to find a new opportunity and take it. What better day to embrace that idea than 2/22/2022?  This date occurs on the 22nd day of Chinese New Year, the year of the Tiger. The number 2 is considered highly auspicious in China, so the date 2/22/2022 could be the luckiest of all days.

As an artist, I look for connections and take chances often, which I think is a common thread for many of us in the crypto community. We look beyond the norm and imagine a future of possibilities. So I created this Blueprint with the mindset of how we can make meaning from the hand we are dealt. 

The number 2 represents a pair in Chinese culture, and many consider the date 2/22/2022 especially lucky for love. Each edition includes a sidekick animal, with symbolic characteristics which may represent you, someone close to you, or someone who could become significant to you in 2022. Symbols for prosperity, luck, longevity, and double happiness alternate in the center.

Rarities for this Blueprint include the Golden Tiger and the Jade Tiger.  The five traditional Elements are represented by a pattern in the lower right, with Water as a rarity for the Element of 2022.  Two legendary editions feature the Yin Yang figures of Tiger and Dragon, with the Chinese knot.

I tend to make connections everywhere. Thus, I'm reminded of this quote from the Roman philosopher Seneca, “Luck Is What Happens When Preparation Meets Opportunity.” 
Let’s prepare for a whole year of 2nd chances, starting with the luckiest day on 2/22/2022!

Qmf5yUEWra9nVQHkHndY9MnhZs3jufuwQYjWpkbR.name: Words #012
Qmf5yUEWra9nVQHkHndY9MnhZs3jufuwQYjWpkbR.description:
What if rarity was based on who owns the NFT instead of its traits ? 

First Words generates an imaginary conversation between you and another owner. A snapshot of a moment in time including thoughts and emotional reactions to the conversation.

Where the magic happens is the bottom right corner.
Each blueprint has embedded a three digit number that is randomly generated at mint (777 Max). 
That means at birth, every piece creates a connection between two owners. 

For example, you minted "Words #333" and inside your blueprint #777 was generated. You are now connected to whoever minted "Words #777".

What you do with that connection is up to you.

Wouldn’t it be crazy if the answer to “how did you meet?" was "randomly generated digital art” ?
What if your blueprint is connected to XCOPY's mint ? Would it be worth more for that reason alone?

There is different ways to interpret and experiment with First Words, but I recommend starting with the following:

Once you minted yours, find who you are connected to, and tweet at them a compliment. Maybe you like an idea they shared, a new art piece, or they have an awesome profile pic. 

Start with kindness, you never know where it takes you.

QmXfK6NNAfivE1FDXBchkxZKFzeP4HhXSCb9AEc8.name: Sketch #004
QmXfK6NNAfivE1FDXBchkxZKFzeP4HhXSCb9AEc8.description:
This is a mixed media project that brings together a huge collection of drawings and doodles that I've done over the years. It combines pen, pencil, marker, watercolour, photography, textures and filters with digital compositing to create whole new pieces of art. 

It was a really fun project to bring together, sifting through my sketchbooks and picking out the ones that form a theme. Clicking the layers on and off and seeing what happens, playing with the randomizer, and letting the kind of dark, gritty, grungy theme emerge naturally. If I may even say so, some even look like they were supposed to be like that!

The coolest part of the Blueprints concept is that everyone that buys one will own a certified unique 1/1 artwork that even I haven't seen yet. There are over 21,000 unique combinations possible, and there are some really cool ones in there! 

Hope you like it! 

Ronan

* There are 10 Legendary Editions. Some are my favourite compositions and others are simply 1/1 of the original artworks

Inspired by the design work of Bauhaus textile artists such as Gunta Stölzl, Anni and Josef Albers, 'Lebras' combines the proportions of both the Silver and Golden Ratios (1.414:1 and 1.618:1 respectively) to create a versatile five-column grid, within which unique compositions are formed. 

Repetition, material, balance, and overlaps are used to generate a near-endless variety of designs, ranging from ultra-minimal, to rhythmic and textural. Four fabric types are available, further adding to the authentic textile quality of the outputs. 

To enjoy 'Lebras' compositions at their best, please view at full size.

QmU873aK7bs9rAQRfwJnGcz6FBJM9th4ahGaGBjx.name: London #114
QmU873aK7bs9rAQRfwJnGcz6FBJM9th4ahGaGBjx.description:
It was during the early days of the outbreak and I was out on the street taking photographs. Just past the Chinese Lunar New Year and the accompanying celebrations, Chinatown was tired under the sparkling red lanterns. Television was full of Wuhan news but there were neither masks nor hospitalizations in London. I spent over a week as tension slowly grew but as the photographer tourist, it was not until the return voyage I realized the gravity of the situations.

These photographs are chosen from my shots during that period. I omitted the out of London photographs and certain themes and images used elsewhere naturally did not make the cut. Of the remaining ones, I tried to be inclusive as well as balanced. After review I realized I have over 300 shots eligible in Landscape and some more in Portrait. Funny that the most strategic decision was choose among them.

I chose the Landscape as it was a lower number :) Not much more sense to it I guess..

This is a set I enjoyed shooting and editing. All are my photographs and 1/1s. Some are heavily edited out of photographic form in to something more akin to abstract mixed media. Others are plain vanilla B&Ws.

There are no combination or overlays as per Async Art algo here. This is playing with the great Blueprints tool to provide you randomization in minting. Basically there are 227 photographs here. All are very dear to me and none of know which one is going to get minted with the click. However unlike other works of mine, if we together get to the end then all 227 will be minted. We just would not know who will have which one!

No Legendary editions here. Rarities also have no meaning. All is rare to the bone. Some are real cool shots, others are like documentaries and yet others are my imagination gone wild.

If you enjoy this, if we mint all then perhaps I'll go over the Portraits and do a London with another count and share all the output with you. As I arrange all this in late January 2022, that seems far away.

To each of my collectors I will end with a final thank you. This has been an amazing journey in the NFT space and only possible with your support. I hope you enjoy this as much as I did and do..

HoT @2022

QmQWz6WPQXbMfFZYBN9NTAAW2otfTLspjyVi2KUe.description:
In both Christianity and Islam, the divine garden is a sacred motif: all the senses are stimulated and there is order and peace. But what if you can't visit the garden? What if the gates to heaven remain closed to you?! How can someone inside enjoy all that splendor if they know that the gate remains closed to others?

It is a dilemma of inclusivity and exclusivity. You always belong to a group, but not everyone belongs to the group that is well off or you want to belong to, and for some, the grass is always greener on the other side. So there is also a second dilemma: comparison.

Does Paradise have multiple gardens? If so, would some be more pleasant and beautiful than others? This garden has one thousand token holders that have access to the most exhilarating pond in paradise. By holding the token, you yourself become a gatekeeper. What kind of gatekeeper do you choose to be?

++++

One thousand gatekeepers of the most exhilarating pond in paradise has 1000 editions. The Krona Museum in the Netherlands will mint this work too. By doing so they will be the first museum or one of the first museums in the Netherlands to include an NFT in their collection. 

I will use an artwork from their collection to add an extra layer to this piece and print those as fine art prints. These prints will be available in the museum only.

Async OG Rutger van der Tas also contributed to One thousand gatekeepers. He made one of the “Gods” at the top of the work. If you are lucky, you might catch his layer!

I worked on One thousand gatekeepers for two months. Each layer is made with great effort, more than you would expect of a digital artwork. The haste with which we currently consume images may be valued differently in the future and you may be someone who wants to look at a digital artwork longer and more intensively than a few seconds. I hope so, because the experience of art is best when it is intense. I hope you will enjoy my genesis piece on async blue prints.

Niels Broszat

QmZx8aUjRuBsAqep4etRSpRydUVoXbPRRvqkVsTM.name: In the Clod #095
QmZx8aUjRuBsAqep4etRSpRydUVoXbPRRvqkVsTM.description: During the university I lived in the same building for a few years. When I left I realized that I didn't know my neighbors with whom we hardly said goodbye. This is not because we were on bad terms, but because over time no one has tried to get to know the other. Perfect strangers next door. The clod 216 was born from this thought, which unlike the others, instead of showing what happens outside, tells what happens inside. There are several stories that can be crossed in the apartments and in the other spaces of the building. In this work I investigate what is hidden where our gaze cannot reach. Story of human situations, often difficult, sometimes strange. Some of these I have lived, others I have imagined. Whatever the case may be, my intent is to arouse reflection in those who look at my work.

QmYYUuVcjJPSvSUzuVCzx27jZPfhoJrHWeNJMaUR.name: Buffalo #014
QmYYUuVcjJPSvSUzuVCzx27jZPfhoJrHWeNJMaUR.description:
Welcome to the Buffalo Book Club!  

This buffalo character is one I have been playing with for almost a year now - as a long time resident of the state of Oklahoma in the United States, the buffalo is arguably the most iconic animal in this part of the country. From our NBA team mascot to bicycle racks at coffee shops, you will find the buffalo and its likeness is a beloved figure in our communities. 

I have two primary goals for this collection: One is to provide uniquely generated PFP NFTs with artwork and cuteness on par with other popular PFP collections. The second is to create a community which prioritizes kindness and inclusivity over flipping and profits - don't get me wrong, I know we'd all like to make some money, but I believe that the collective imaginations of a like-minded community has more potential to achieve a goal than a greedy group of strangers with an "every man/woman/other for themself" mindset. Also, I am well aware that others' strengths might be my weaknesses, so if you join and have ANY ideas, I hope you will speak up and share them. At this point, everything has been done by one person, so I commit to remaining humble and taking any and all ideas into consideration. 

If this Async collection sells out, I will create a team and release a 10k item collection with updated artwork, deploy a smart contract, create a whitepaper, and a full project roadmap. Upon sellout, this Async.art blueprint collection of buffalo will be considered the "Genesis Collection" - meaning anyone holding a Genesis Buffalo Book Club NFT will get special perks such as access to...
- "The BuffaDAO" - the heart of the bookclub and a future DAO where the community will be able to vote and make proposals concerning the future of the project
- a free web domain per buffalo ("yournamehere.buffalobc" via HNS network) which will grant holders access to the entire HNS ecosystem, including identity
- one free mint per buffalo for the 10k collection launch
- announcement of philanthropic sponsorship (A Local Oklahoma Tallgrass Prairie Preserve)
- full 3D renderings of buffalos
- integration of buffalos into multiple popular metaverses & other NFT platforms
- Artist and musician collective
- SO much more TBA upon 100% sales


Additionally, I have and will continue to reach out to businesses in regard to sponsoring of traits in the future primary collection (think about other popular "buffalo"...)

I have also reached out to Amazon/Audible in an attempt to discuss potentially paying to have all holders granted access to a collection of books on Audible and or providing copies of books to those who would like one. 

There are over 420 MILLION possible combinations that can occur, but only 500 can be created - ten of which are legendary editions - who will mint the Albino Great White Buffalo?

Qmd2FE18pLUBmx5bCzu5masP3pcuccrDCVSbihxB.name: The feast of Morpheus #04
Qmd2FE18pLUBmx5bCzu5masP3pcuccrDCVSbihxB.description:
"The feast of Morpheus" depicts a naked girl using an Extended reality device. I use psychedelic colors and shapes to represent the girl who is immersed in an unreal, dreamlike state.

"In 2021, the number of internet users worldwide stood at 4.9 billion, which means that almost two thirds of the global population is currently connected to the world wide web."

"Added together, the world’s internet users will spend more than 1.4 billion years of combined human existence online in 2022."

Today, with the continuous advancement of various technologies related to Extended reality, we cannot foresee what kind of new world the technology will bring us in the future, just as it was hard for us to imagine it 20 years ago. The development of technology and the Internet has brought such huge changes and convenience in our lifes. But also unforeseable problems that come with it, such as : Internet addiction, privacy issues and frauds...

As technology continues to evolve, can old and new problems be solved one by one? Will we have a brighter future? Or becoming "The feast of Morpheus"?

“墨菲斯的盛宴”描绘了一个使用扩展现实设备的裸体女孩。 我用迷幻的颜色和形状来表现沉浸在虚幻、梦幻般的状态中的女孩。

“2021 年，全球互联网用户数量达到 49 亿，这意味着全球近三分之二的人口目前已连接到万维网。”
“到 2022 年，全球互联网用户加在一起将在网上度过14 亿年，超过人类生存的时间。”

在扩展现实的各种相关技术不断进步的今天，我们无法预见未来科技会带给我们怎样的新世界，正如20年前的我们难以想象科技与互联网的发展带给了我们的生活如此巨大的改变与便利，也无法预见随之而来的各种问题：网络成瘾，隐私安全，网络诈骗......

在科技不断发展的同时，旧的问题会和新问题一起逐一解决吗？我们会迎来更加光明的未来吗？亦或是变成一场"墨菲斯的盛宴"呢？

And also to Punk Rock, Crypto Art, Trash art, Glitch Art, Rebel Rock, Punk Art, Pop Art, Naïve Art, The Situationists, The Dadaists  and all the other underground, grass roots, music & art movements that have attempted to rock the system, affect change & champion creativity - here's to the mould-breakers. QmdADBQjAqxk3aENzJPvh12VqfDq95sDvQB5oFJQ.name: Raving Hell #15
QmdADBQjAqxk3aENzJPvh12VqfDq95sDvQB5oFJQ.description:
Welcome to the third collection – Hell terrified and enraptured people with its journey through the lands of the dead. After all, wandering through bleak environments and simply talking to suffering people doesn't sound like an interesting hobby. Regardless, each Illustration is minutely detailed with touches seemingly pulled from the Canvas.

Discover life on hell, relationships, which may become someone becomes a personal hell.  Realm, divided from the land of the living by a terrible river, a house of dust where the dead dwell without distinction of rank or merit.

Across the River Styx on Charon’s ferry inhabitants sunk into witless oblivion, incapable of communicating with him. The untimely dead and the improperly buried suffer more than do common shades, and notorious sinners such as Tantalus, Putler, and Sisyphus, are tormented for crimes.

As you make your way through hell there are damned souls that you can choose to punish or absolve. You can also snap up the lower minions of hell. The landscape of hell is a powerful character in its own right, but that doesn't mean there aren't other manifestations of evil. Each of the six canvases has its own take on the denizens of hell and One Unique Legendary Illustration, as well as rare types of traits such as Lava, Gold, Acid, and Epic, define the original palette and hidden treasures.

Surprised at what an important role sound plays in the artistic version of hell. The sound is key to the equal canvas parts of 7 Unique Legendary editions.

QmeY31cExCtwqdhC12LPGymtnFnQoyMHpkWJpeZ7.name: RECYCLED TRASH #12
QmeY31cExCtwqdhC12LPGymtnFnQoyMHpkWJpeZ7.description: RECYCLED TRASH is a collage experiment made from the discarded generations of my AI art process.  Exploring AI art can be seen as wasteful. Often I curate one or two quality images for every 25-50 generated.  When my hard drive ran out of space I looked at all the leftover, unused files generated in the creation of my various art works and thought what can I do with all these PNGs that used so many GPU cycles? I experimented layering them with each other, solid colors and line art in a variety of ways and came up with RECYCLED TRASH, A GENERATIVE TRASH ART COLLAGE. There are 10 legendary GOLDEN TOTERS in this collection that the may be exchanged one time for a custom commission from XWAVE on the topic of your choice.

QmciyVBoi9i4urEL8fmRju9kmrv3Ap7jTs8E4NAB.name: Crypto Martyr #0
QmciyVBoi9i4urEL8fmRju9kmrv3Ap7jTs8E4NAB.description:
According to official sources, there are well over 10,000 venerated Catholic saints scribbled into the archives of liturgical history, but ask yourself this… How many saints performed miracles and lived blessed lives that eluded the eyes and the quills of the church?

Our Lady of Non-Fungibility presents Crypto Martyrs... a generative collection that seeks to shine a light on the long lost heroes from the shadowed past just waiting to be unearthed by you! These statues reflect a plethora of remarkable lives cut short by the hands of the fearful and it’s up to all of us to revive their legacies, their miracles and their ultimate downfalls. Become a scribe in our mission to fill in the blanks and render a colorful tapestry of Crypto Martyrs!

Once minted, you’ll have the opportunity to visit our Discord server to log an entry detailing the lore of your newly discovered martyr! We encourage you to flex your creative muscles and make your saint’s life story as unique as your own! And once you’ve joined the congregation, we invite you to take part in a variety of community events and future releases all in the name of blessedly non-fungible fun!

Our team of scholars tells us that the number of unique statues to be found is staggering! And keep in mind, there are whispers of some statues so legendarily blessed by the hand of the creator that they are too dazzling to behold… 

May your journey be blessed and your discoveries plentiful!

Visit our official webpage via the link provided to explore the features mentioned above.

So, it seems that wherever we go we leave some sort of crap encrusted footprint behind that bears witness to our foray into any previously pristine domain.
Is our myopic lack of foresight and seeming inability to plan for the full impact of our incursions an inherent aspect of our DNA or does it generate from laziness, greed, insatiable desire for power, or...?

QmVXz8kbL98fPTsJnHEf16wtcsxhi3gSbouwm1pz.description:
Our Spring Was Endless seeks to illuminate the nuances of a faraway life —its fondest moments and its darkest— oftentimes all at once.

This collaboration combines poetry, hand-drawn illustrations, and Burmese culture to honor Myanmar's 2021 Spring Revolution. Illustrator Ntxoo Tori Hong and poet Thet-Htar weave Thet-Htar's experiences resisting the brutal military regime and Ntxoo's witnessing and support as an ally from afar.

100% of the primary proceeds from this collection will be donated to 501(c)(3) fiscally sponsored charity Karen Women’s Organization via Every.org. KWO provides emergency assistance to Indigenous women and children displaced by the military junta in Karen State, Myanmar.

Qme8HAUBiJvhb2yH3xFYFnNkoZsqJiLTJQVca76n.description:
SK8. is Sean Jantzi's first generative digital art collection. This series of one hundred unique works is derived from over 25 unique attributes and includes one legendary, "SK8. POOL."

Jantzi's unique PoV style blends a modern flair with retro influence from Pop Art greats such as Tom Wesselmann and David Hockney.  Sean has a deep rooted love for nostalgia and vibrant times that emanate from his body of artwork.

Each collector will be eligible to win a one of one hand SK8. sketch on paper, hand signed by Sean Jantzi. The winner will be randomly selected after all 100 SK8. artworks are minted and announced on Sean Jantzi's Twitter handle - https://twitter.com/sean_jantzi and Instagram handle - https://instagram.com/seanjantzi

Happy Collecting!
